L0: # Mock Adapter Developer Guide
L1: ## Overview
L2: 
L3: The Mock Adapter is a full-featured AdCP-compliant testing adapter that simulates ad server behavior without requiring external API credentials or making real API calls. It's designed for:
L4: - **Local development** - Test AdCP integrations without connecting to real ad servers
L5: - **CI/CD testing** - Fast, deterministic tests for automated pipelines
L6: - **AI agent development** - Accelerated delivery simulation for testing agent responses
L7: - **Protocol compliance testing** - Validate AdCP V2.3 specification adherence
L8: ## Supported Capabilities
L9: ### ✅ Fully Supported AdCP Operations
L10: 
L11: The mock adapter implements all AdCP V2.3 operations:
L12: | Operation | Support Level | Notes |
L13: |-----------|--------------|-------|
L14: | **`get_products`** | ✅ Full | Returns mock product catalog |
L15: | **`create_media_buy`** | ✅ Full | Creates in-memory campaigns with validation |
L16: | **`sync_creatives`** | ✅ Full | Simulates creative upload and approval |
L17: | **`get_media_buy_delivery`** | ✅ Full | Returns simulated delivery metrics |
L18: | **`update_media_buy`** | ✅ Full | Supports pause, resume, budget updates |
